title: Headrest adjustment and height-related comfort
summary: Feedback in this topic centers mainly on headrest adjustment and seating comfort, with many additional fragments too brief or unclear to support a firm sentiment reading.

positive.summary: One positive review praises the roof height for making entry and exit easier and more comfortable.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews describe headrests that are hard to adjust or push the driver's head too far forward, while also reflecting a desire for a more comfortable position.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly mention headrest or height without enough context to tell whether the customer experience was favorable, unfavorable, or purely informational.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined or very short, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
This topic cluster mixes headrest-specific comments with broader height references such as roof, trunk, and ground height, so it is not fully coherent as a single issue.
